import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    x = int(data[1])
    y = int(data[2])

    dp = [0] * (2 * n + 1)
    dp[1] = x

    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        half = (i + 1) // 2
        dp[i] = min(dp[i - 1] + x, dp[half] + y + (i % 2) * x)
        dp[i - 1] = min(dp[i - 1], dp[i] + x)

    print(dp[n])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
